name: Tom Sojer
beschreibung: Hotel Tom Sojer is centrally located in Ellmau, a village in the Tiroler Unterland at the foot of the Wilder Kaiser. The surroundings offer access to hiking trails and the Wilder Kaiser-Brixental ski area. The house itself exudes a simple, alpine elegance. Guests can expect a stay with personal service and traditional home-style cuisine. Parking spaces and a terrace are part of the amenities.
